reason: Root noticed SELECT * returned unnecessary candidate/capability metadata from same scoped rows. Independent review classified narrowing as a useful routine refinement, with no demonstrated leak, authority expansion or product P1/P2.
change: Return original six catalog fields plus park_id and optional original publication journal/head, rather than all row columns.
limitation: to_jsonb(r) still constructs a row inside PostgreSQL. No claim that database internals avoid other columns or that row byte size is strictly bounded.
